newsitem.title: USA: PIMCO in $265 mln deal with Oppenheimer.
newsitem.headline: PIMCO in $265 mln deal with Oppenheimer.

text.p: PIMCO Advisors LP and its affiliate Thomson Advisory Group Inc have signed a definitive agreement to buy certain interests from Oppenheimer Group Inc, the companies announced Friday.
The agreement provides for an overall price of about $265 million in preferred stock and assumption of debt, they said.

The transaction covers only the private interests Oppenheimer Group holds in Oppenheimer Capital and Oppenheimer Capital L.P. and does not include the publicly traded units of Oppenheimer Capital, L.P., they said.
